paite: Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai thu noute suunna ding ka gen za un.
heading: Kisik Ding A Chialna

paite: Nungak, Israel, apukta hi; adingh nawn kei ding; agam tung ah paihkhiak ahita; amah tungding ding kuamah a-om kei.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel chite kiang ah, khopi sangkhat pawtna in zakhat anuse ding a, khopi zakhat pawtna in sawmkhat anuse ding hi.”
TOUPA'N Israel inkote kiang ah hichi in achi:

"Hon zong un, na hing ding uh; himahleh Bethel khua zong kei unla, Gilgal ah lut sam kei un, Beer-sheba ah galkah kei unla; pel lou in Gilgal khua sal in aman ding a, Bethel khua ahong vuaksuak ding hi."
TOUPA zong unla, na hing ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Joseph inn ah mei bang in apawt ding a, akang khin ding a, Bethel ah mitsak ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
Vaihawmna singkha suaksak a, diktatna lei a paikhete aw;
siguk leh zuheisuktun bawlpa leh sihna limliap lak a tangsakpa leh sun zanmial a bawlpa, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a luangsakpa, amah tak zong le uchin; amin TOUPA ahi;
kulh tung a manthatna hong tung guih zou hial a, mihatte tung a manthatna tungsakpa pen.
Kongpi ah taihilhmi amudah ua, thudiktak genmi akih uhi.
heading: Pathian Deih Louh Khohei Gamtat

paite: Huaiziak in migentheite tuanden in buh na laksak ua; suangsek in innte na lam ua, himahleh asung ah na teng kei ding uh. Grephuan nuamte na bawl ua, himahleh uain na dawn kei ding uhi.
Na tatleknate uh tamdan leh na khelhnate uh athupidan lah ka thei ngal a; midiktatte na simmoh ua, golhna la a, kongpi a tasamte ahih ding him ua pampaihte aw.
Huchi in hun hoih lou ahih ziak in mipil zaw huai hun chiang in adai dide ding hi.
Na hintheihna ding un hoihlouhna zong lou in, hoihna zong unla; huan na gen bang un, TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
Khelhna hua unla, hoihna it un; kongpi ah vaihawmna kiptak in tungding un; Joseph inkuan akhosuaksunte tung ah TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in hehpihna anei kha mai ding hi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa'n hichi in achi: "Kongzing teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a, lamliante tengteng ah, khawk hi na mah e; achi ding uh; lungkham ding in lounei mite leh nakpi a kap ding in sisuun siamte asam ding uhi.
Grephuan teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a; na lak uah ka paisuak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA ni deihte aw, na tung uh agik hi! Bangziak a TOUPA ni deih na hia ua? Vak hilou in mial ahi zaw hi.
Humpinelkai taisan a, vompi tuak mi bang leh inn a lut a, baang tung a khut nga a gul in atuk bang ahi.
TOUPA ni vak hilou in mial ahi sin kei a hia? Mial sah leh vakna nei lou in?
"Na ankuangluite uh ka hua in ka musit a, na kikhawmpi pisuakte uah leng ka kipak sam kei hi.
Ahi, na thillat uleh na buh lat uh hon lan mah le uchin, ka sang kei ding, na gan thau uh lemna thillatte leng ka limsak sam kei ding hi.
Na kaihging ging kilawm uh ka ngaikhe kei ding; huaiziak in kei a kipan bil aphuai na late uh lamang un.
Himahleh vaihawmna bel tuite bang in leh diktatna lui lian bang in luang hen," TOUPA'N achi.
"Aw Israel inkote aw, kum sawmli sung in gamdai ah kithoihnate leh thillatte ka kiang ah na hon lan ngei ua hia?
Ahi, na milim uh Molok leh na milimte uh Kaiuan, na aksi pathian uh, noute ding in na tawisang zaw uhi.
TOUPA amin sepaihte' Pathian in, noute Damaskas kho khen ah sal in ka hon paisak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
